artifact_diffs: Created 23 source-anchored language units across all 12 available chapter classes, led by eight Summary and five Introduction units.
Added P13 as the fourth independent source for LP-A-ABS-TASK-METHOD-RESULT, LP-A-ABS-BOUNDARY, LP-A-ABS-PARAGRAPH-CHAIN, and LP-A-INT-RESEARCH-GAP.
Explicitly excluded P13 from LP-A-ABS-MODEL-STAIRCASE and LP-A-INT-METHOD-ROADMAP because its Summary modules and Introduction process list are parallel rather than dependent.
Added respectively as a positive mapping device and four bounded negative diagnostics for unmeasured validity, relationship strength, accuracy/convenience, and explanatory claims.
Created a validated paper card and 34 atomic observations, with language as the largest dimension at 12 observations and weakness restricted to one synthesis observation.
Created 8 formula-level model units containing 19 visually checked equations and explicit classification, light-to-size, and alternative-mass dependency edges.
Appended evidence to 12 existing A rules without changing lifecycle states.
Recorded complete visual review for all 54 pages.

validation_results.details: 34 observations, 41 A rules, and 54 visually reviewed pages.
23 source-anchored language units across all 12 available chapter classes.
Four recurring patterns gained an independent content identity; parallel modules were not counted as staircases or dependency roadmaps.
8 models and 19 core equations passed variable, dependency, and visual-check validation.
All 54 rendered pages passed image and complete visual-review checks.

unresolved_added: Leaf-image selection, scale calibration, and the LEA extraction algorithm are not reported.
The selection and stability of four Ward clusters are not demonstrated.
The neural test lacks independent botanical labels and gives conflicting architecture descriptions.
The overlap projection matrix and later displacement equations use inconsistent tangent conventions.
No observed shadow masks validate the overlap model.
The light-field coefficients, units, radial boundary, and fitted residuals are absent.
No measured leaf-area/irradiance data calibrate the modified logistic response.
The branch-pattern classifier lacks a documented train-test split, calibration, confusion matrix, and coefficient uncertainty.
The volumetric density and attenuation coefficient have unresolved units and estimation.
The final quadratic DBH coefficients are not reported.
The same 14 trees appear to fit and evaluate the leaf-mass models without holdout.
Per-case residuals and uncertainty are absent from the final mass-model comparison.
